Twenty-one comments

Paidín Ó Raifearta

Really nice jig in A as played by the amazing Tim Collins on his amazing album ‘Dancing on Silver’.

[N.B. This is NOT the same tune as the jig commonly played in sessions round here as Paddy (O) Rafferty’s, and to be found in it’s ABCs at Henrik Norbek’s file ‘Jigs3’. For some reason I quite dislike that tune by this name…]

↳ Posted by petemay on November 21st, 2004.
